title: Circulating pre-osteoclasts are primed for osteoclast fate and synovial tissue homing in psoriatic arthritis
description: Plate-based single-cell RNA-sequencing (VASA-seq) was performed on FACS-sorted pre-osteoclast and monocyte populations from peripheral blood of 2 psoriatic arthritis patients to characterize transcriptional heterogeneity, differentiation states, and osteoclastogenic trajectories at single-cell resolution.
